_about: Copy this file to preferences.json and make it yours. Every value here drives the worth-it filter (docs/FILTER.md).

compensation.note: A job passes on pay if it meets EITHER the yearly floor (salary roles) OR the hourly floor (hourly roles). Pay must be verified in the posting itself, never assumed.

exclusions.degree_walls: Kill roles that require a completed degree unless the posting's own words accept equivalent experience.
exclusions.experience_walls: Kill roles requiring 4+ years in a specialty you do not have. Never inflate your record to clear a wall.

distance_bands_miles.over_30: only if pay is exceptional for the tier

location.hybrid_note: Weight a hybrid commute by in-office days per week: 2 anchor days at 25 miles can beat 5 days at 15.
location.relocation_note: If open to relocation, say so here (for example: 'yes, with relocation assistance').

protected_schedule.rule: These blocks are walls. A role whose stated schedule collides with one is killed, and nothing (interviews, shifts, calls) is ever scheduled over them. Keep this list in sync with your real calendar.

references.note: Set named_references_available to the number you can honestly name today. Zero is a valid answer; the filter handles it.
references.policy: Roles requiring 2 or more named professional references up front are a hard stop. 'References available on request' is fine.

writing_rules: Nothing is submitted, sent, or posted without my approval of the exact text.
Follow-ups must add something new each time: a detail, a new angle, a graceful close. No 'just checking in'.
Keep messages in my voice: plain, direct, no corporate filler.
